title: Skateboard trickster
description: This mod adds a skateboard to the game which can be used for moving fast and it can be used to perform tricks as well.
body:
SkateMod introduces a fully functional skateboarding mechanic to Minecraft, transforming how players traverse the world. This mod adds a custom skateboard entity that provides a faster, more engaging way to travel across diverse terrain. By crafting and placing the board, players can mount and control it, allowing for smooth movement across blocks.

**Key Features:**
Custom Skateboard Entity: A dedicated entity designed for riding, featuring responsive movement controls that allow for precise navigation around obstacles. This skateboard also emits flame particles while moving, leaving a trail behind

Stunt System: Players can trigger three random dynamic tricks while riding by pressing the K key. Executing stunts provides an interactive experience, complete with custom audio effects and visual feedback.

Movement Mechanics: The board features a specialized physics system, including the ability to clear small gaps and navigate various surfaces.

Immersive Soundscape: Custom audio triggers accompany rolling on the ground and performing stunts, ensuring that every movement feels grounded and responsive.

Interactive Controls: The movement system listens for player input, requiring active navigation to maintain speed and maneuverability.
